outlook.statement: The Indian hospitality industry continues to demonstrate resilience and growth, supported by strong domestic demand, a revival in international travel, and evolving consumer preferences. FY 2025–26 is expected to be a year of consolidation and strategic expansion for hotel operators across segments.

The company plans to explore and tap overseas markets. The company also proposes to bring in new products and services which shall be first launched in the domestic markets and then shall be introduced in the overseas markets.

risks: Cost pressure, talent availability, alternative accommodation through online route like OYO, Airbnb etc. (Hotel Division)
Industry preparing to take share of opportunities expected to arise out of market freed from quota restrictions and other trade barriers; operators moving towards modernization and expansion.
